name: NVIDIA Corporation
businessDescription: NVIDIA Corporation provides graphics and compute and networking solutions. The Graphics segment offers GeForce GPUs for gaming and PCs, the GeForce NOW game streaming service, and platforms for gaming. The Compute & Networking segment includes Data Center accelerated computing platforms, automotive AI platforms, and DGX systems for AI training and inference. The company sells its products to original equipment manufacturers, original design manufacturers, cloud service providers, automotive manufacturers, and consumer internet companies.
